creator.description:
Labeler for flagging suspected AI imagery.

To verify the labels on your account or read our handbook:
https://query.aimod.social

Appeals: please send a report. We do not regularly check this account for tags.

Art theft: report to @arttheft.bsky.social

locales.description: Includes self-proclaimed or suspected AI imagery, but the post is not the primary source and the image is specifically used in the context of education, examination, or critical evaluation.
locales.name: AI Informative

locales.description: This image isn't specifically AI, but we suspect AI was used as part of its creation process. This could mean, for instance, an artist who created a piece by tracing AI.
locales.name: Suspected AI Assisted Imagery

locales.description: A non-AI image that we suspect was modified by AI, such as by using a neural net based filter. For example, AI upscaling.
locales.name: Suspected AI Modified Imagery

locales.description: We suspect the user's profile picture or header image uses generated AI imagery, or was modified by AI such as by a neural-net filter.
locales.name: Suspected AI Imagery in Avatar or Banner

locales.description: An account that has posted suspected AI imagery more than once, although it is not their primary content. Applied to indicate repeat behaviour rather than a one-off.
locales.name: Occasionally Posts Suspected AI

locales.description: An account we believe to be AI image focused, or that posts suspected AI imagery frequently or in large amounts.
locales.name: Frequently Posts Suspected AI

locales.description: An image or video that we suspect to be AI generated, or to contain AI generated imagery - such as a screenshot of a news article with an AI image inset, or a drawn picture with an AI background.
locales.name: Suspected AI Imagery
